text:
maria: morning — alert fired for APAC p99 API latency, lots of customer 504/timeout reports. Observability shows p99 generation latency jumped from ~120ms to ~1.6s around 03:10 UTC. link: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/apac/p99-latency

deploy-bot: rollout completed: nv-driver v525.30 + gpu-fw v2.14 deployed to apac-canary @ 02:45 UTC (commit: 9f3b2a1).
support_john: we have 6 fresh CS tickets from APAC customers — request ids: rq_9a1b, rq_9a2c, rq_9a7f. Symptoms: stalled streaming chunk, then 504s. Customers seeing increased token timeouts.
kai: can someone grab iostat, nvme stats and dmesg from a few affected hosts? suspect hostfs nvme write stalls after driver/fw update. commands to run:
```
# on node
sudo iostat -x 1 5
sudo nvme smart-log /dev/nvme0n1
sudo dmesg -T | tail -n 100
sudo nvidia-smi --query-gpu=timestamp,utilization.gpu,temperature.gpu --format=csv -l 1 -c 5
```
jamie: looking at traces, we see repeated KV cache miss spikes and sudden increase in host IO during long prompt requests (seq len ~2k). cache eviction rate jumped ~8x. suspect kernel driver interaction + firmware causing higher hostfs write latency.
sre_bot: grafana panels: p99 by pod, nvme write latency, kvcache evictions: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/apac/p99-kv-nvme - spike correlates with driver rollout at 02:45 UTC.
ops-ryan: temporarily routing policy applied to reduce load on APAC: moved 30% of traffic to eu-west1 and enabled model-fallback to smaller quantized variant. Command used: `rwctl route update --region apac --weight eu-west1=30 --model-fallback small-quant-v1`.
maria: thanks — please collect iostat/nvme/dmesg from 3 different host families (g5g, a10, a100) and attach. Support, ask customers for one failing request id and timestamp so we can correlate.
support_john: forwarded to customers for logs, got one back (rq_9a2c @ 03:12:08 UTC) — attaching headers and short transcript.
kai: initial checks: nvme queues show occasional 500-800ms write latencies on impacted hosts, dmesg shows repeated NVME timeouts around the same window, also see some NVRM messages after driver install. saving logs to /var/log/incident/1716543210/.
jamie: mitigation plan proposal: 1) pause driver/fw rollout for remaining APAC nodes; 2) rollback drivers on a small bucket (3 hosts) to v525.22 to validate; 3) increase kvcache memory allotment for real-time groups and warm cache; 4) keep routing fallback until p99 < 300ms for 30m. I'll open PRs for cache tweak and rollback playbook.
maria: assign actions — kai rollback triage + log collection, jamie cache change + validation, ops-ryan keep routing/fallback, support_john continue customer comms.
deploy-bot: rollback started on canary subset (hosts: apac-g5g-canary-01..03), jobs kicked.
sre_bot: monitoring: p99 dropping from 1.6s -> 850ms on partial routing, KV miss rate down slightly after cache warm commands. still unstable.
maria: keep me posted in thread. if rollback on canary reproduces improvement, we'll schedule bulk rollback and driver hold.
customer-alert-bot: customer alert updated: severity -> high, affected orgs: 4, estimated impact: degraded latency for generation APIs in APAC.
ops-ryan: note — if rollback not enough, we may need to throttle long prompt lengths for APAC via gateway policy as emergency mitigation.
maria: agreed. final quick checklist: collect logs, confirm canary rollback impact, keep routing/fallback, patch cache, notify CS + oncall. tagging oncall: @kai.
kai: acknowledged, running bisect and will report findings in next 20m.
support_john: pinged the 4 customers with mitigation update and ETA. one customer asked for SLA credit process — flagged to finance.
maria: thanks everyone.
customer-alert-bot: incident thread updated with status: investigating -> mitigations applied. expected next update in 15m.
